text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tap!
Part-time boss insisted bringing this.
Paint for props!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Tap, brought goods!
Brought theater buddy along for extra
hands!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hoh, nice work, y'all! Captain's gonna jump for joy, bet on it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Tap! Introduce these fine folks first,
if you please desu wa?
Fresh faces I haven't seen on campus…

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
These are my pals!
Looked out for me before coming to campus.
Super reliable folks!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My crew is your crew!
More hands make unstoppable force ——

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend C
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa?! Who did that! Paint all over me!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend D
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Nice tail color!
Too focused on paintin' to notice―
W-Whoa, easy with fists!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—— Hahaha! Make some noise!
…Way more fun when everyone pitches in,
right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
…Indeed. Far grander this way desu wa.
Thank you, Tap… let us proceed!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ladies and gentlemen,
thank you so much for your cooperation,
desu wa! 
Let us make this play a true showstopper!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—— That stage idea is as lovely as a summer
sunset, desu wa! 
It matches Gimlet's image perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Right? Minute I heard the tale,
figured that 
old-school charm'd fit like a glove.
Did a bit of 
actin' back in the day, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My goodness~!
So that is how you know theatre folk,
desu wa! 
Having an experienced hand around is truly
reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Directooor! Do ya recall which room 
has that sewing machine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I shall be right there, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—— Interesting…… 
So that's how her highness keeps her flock
in line.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
They're F-R-I-E-N-D-S! ……Reckon this here 
gonna be an unforgettable adventure for Fine,
too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Sharin' the load is part of the journey. 
We gotta pour our hearts into actin' for
her sake as well!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: …… Tch. Got other things to worry about……

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(… Everyone is serious about staging a good
play. 
Mission —
As lead, I must perform exceptionally.)

text_block_list.name: Drama Coach
text_block_list.text:
—— Right then,
shall we practice facial expressions? 
Tap, Shakur! Step up!

text_block_list.name: Tap & Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fun! (*ˊᗜˋ*) Happy! (˶˃ ᵕ ˂˶) Sad...
(˙◠˙) Angry! ( •̀ ᴖ •́)
Surprised! (°ロ°) Scared... ₍˶Ó﹏Ò )

text_block_list.name: Drama Coach
text_block_list.text:
Shakur, show more spirit, please! 
Next… Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Happy. Sad. Angry. Surprised. Scared.
[•_•]

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
…… Apologies. Expressing emotion… 
is not my strong suit.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No sweat! Role's a mechanical doll,
ain't it? 
Lackin' emotion might just be what hits the
mark.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps. 
However… Gimlet…

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My conviction remains unshakable —
Kris S, I entrust this destiny unto thee. 
Like bidding farewell to King Lear lost upon
the barren heath, 
we shall stage this tragic parting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Understood. 
―― I want to express… "sadness."

text_block_list.name: Drama Coach
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… delving deeper into character could
help. 
Why not try processing the mechanical doll's
emotions your own way, Kris S?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Mechanical doll embarks on final journey.
Leaving behind 
land of its binding,
toward eternal solitude… 
That grief, the sorrow of parting…)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
…… Farewell. Farewell… 
Farewell…… ―― Negative.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Tap! Is Kris… still having a tough time,
desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
As ya see. Stuck like that all along. 
Though reckon it suits a mechanical doll
just fine.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… would it help if she fully 
immersed herself into the role? 
In that case, allow me……

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~! You two look absolutely magnificent,
desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: …… I am… mechanical doll.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! You appear every bit the flawless 
mechanical doll now,
desu wa. Shall we try the lines again 
with this fresh inspiration?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ―― Hour of departure arrives. Come dawn… I bid thee farewell, venturing forth onto endless journey, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(……I am mechanical doll. Now…… speak 
sorrowful "farewell." For journey ahead……)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: O fiend, one word alone remains — farewell. To time, humanity, the heart itself…… adieu ――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
……… Apologies. 
Execution… flawed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kris, no need for apologies, desu wa. 
You did nothing wrong.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yet… mission objective failed. 
…… Frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kris……

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
… Shakur,
perhaps acting opposite you might prove
easier for Kris? Try something like:
"Shall I cast thee into depths of hell?",
desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not even in the script.
…Can we trash the script already? 
It's still just a rough draft.
Who knows what that idiot is scheming ——

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —— Pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I dared don mantle of a deity, seeking to 
reshape world… Is this my divine
retribution!
